answer: Reputation collateral priced in real compute makes each agent identity carry a bonded reserve of verified GPU cycles, and peers cross-check that reserve through a mirror of prior work receipts before trusting any attestation. Creating a fake identity means pre-paying compute that only returns value after sustained honest output, so a sybil farmer's marginal cost rises with each clone while their payoff stays flat. A velvet-smooth low-cost entry tier exists for newcomers, but it caps influence, and any proven fraud burns the whole compute bond to onyx-black permanence, making mass fakery.
